integrity: Definitions, quantifiers, proof, finite diagnostic script, sources, and limitations are provided; numerical tests supplement but do not establish the infinite-domain theorem.
scientific_limitations: Conditional comparison of exact mean-matched exponential and Gamma exit-time laws with a fixed deterministic competence interval. Exit during competence is not successful settlement, local recruitment, or a calibrated reef prediction. Full-text comparison of one relevant 2010 ecological article was not possible; mathematical historical priority is not independently established.
title: Two-boundary competence-window phase diagram for matched-mean residence clocks
